 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 1.1 All terms, words, and phrases used in this License Agreement are defined herein. Additionally, any terms defined in the Agreement to Sell executed between the Parties and referenced herein shall have the same meaning when used in this License Agreement, unless expressly stated otherwise. In case of any inconsistency or ambiguity between the definitions provided herein and those in the Agreement to Sell, the definitions in the Agreement to Sell shall prevail. 
 GRANT OF LICENSE 
 
 Subject to the provisions of the Agreement to Sell and in consideration of the payment s under clause 5.1 of the Agreement to Sell , the Licensor grant s to the Licensee a n exclusive sublicensable and non-assignable l icense (the “ License ”) to use and occupy the Licensed Unit as per the terms and conditions of the License Agreement . 
 
 The Licensee acknowledges and agrees that this License is only a permission to occupy and use the Licensed Unit, including one (1) designated parking space as specified under Clause 9 of the Agreement to Sell, and does not create or transfer any right, title or interests in the Licensed Unit in favour of the Licensee except to the limited extent of the License granted hereunder . 
 
 The Licensee acknowledges and agrees that all risks, responsibilities and obligations with respect to the Licensed Unit , including loss or damage to the property, shall pass to the Licensee as and from the Effective Dat e. 
 
 LICENSE PERIOD 
 3.1 The Licensor has granted the License for the Licensed Unit, including all fixtures, fittings, appliances, and designated parking space, to the Licensee commencing from the Effective Date of the License Agreement until the Licensee completes the final instalment payment in clear funds according to the Payment Plan appended to the Agreement to Sell (the " License Period ). 
 TERMS OF LICENSE 
 
 The grant of License is conditional upon the following: 
 
 timely and consistent payment of the Instalment Payment and fulfilment of any other payment obligations of the Licensor under the Agreement to Sell ; . 
 t T imely and consistent payment of monthly Service Charges to the Management Company in clear funds; 
 timely and consistent payment of monthly utility charges with respect to the Licensed Unit; 
 strict compliance with the Rules, including but not limited to the Permitted Use specified therein; and 
 maintaining the Licensed Unit in habitable and liveable condition . ; 
 timely and consistent payment of monthly utility charges with respect to the Licensed Unit; and 
 timely and consistent payment of the Instalment Payment and fulfilment of any other payment obligations of the Licensor under the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 The Licensee is under obligation to make payments for Service Charges, as specified in Clause 3.1(i), irrespective of whether the Licensed Unit is occupied or vacant. 
 
 The Licensor shall, to the extent possible, assign to the Licensee the benefit of any valid manufacturers’ warranties at the date of grant of the License, in respect of any White Goods provided in the Licensed Unit under this License Agreement. The Licensor makes no independent representation or warranty in this regard, including with respect to the fitness for use or quality of any White Goods and has relied on the manufacturers’/suppliers’ representations and warranties in this regard issued at and effective from the time of purchase. The Licensor shall have no liability whatsoever with respect to the White Goods, including inter alia the maintenance, replacement, repair or extension in warranty periods thereof. 
 
 The Licensee undertakes to the Licensor that the Licensee not : 
 
 create any partitions or make alter ation s , additions or attachment s, of any nature whatsoever , in relation to the Licensed Unit ; and

 SUBLICENSE 
 
 The Licensee may sublicense the Licensed Unit during the license period after obtaining prior written consent of the Licensor , which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. 
 
 Any sublicense granted : 
 
 shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this License Agreement ; 
 shall be in writing on terms consistent with this License Agreement; and 
 shall not include the right to grant a further sublicense. 
 
 The acts and omissions of a sublicensee shall be deemed to be the acts and omissions of the Licensee for the purpose of this License Agreement. 
 
 The Licensee shall be liable at all times to the Licensor for any breach of the sublicense by the sublicensee including inter alia any loss or damage to the Licensed Unit. 
 
 Any sublicense granted shall automatically terminate on the termination of this License Agreement. 
 
 DEFAULT AND TERMINATION 
 5. 1 The License Agreement shall automatically terminate on the termination of the Agreement to Sell. 
 5.2 The Licensor may terminate this License Agreement i n the event of a breach of obligations hereunder by the Licensee if the Licensee fails to remedy the breach within 7 (seven) days of being notified in writing by the Licensor . 
 5.3 Upon termination of the License Agreement for any reason whatsoever , the Licensee shall vaca te or cause to be vacated the Licensed Unit to the Licensor within 30 (thirty) days from th e date of termination. 
 GENERAL TERMS 
 The License Agreement, along with the Agreement to Sell and all its annexures attached thereto shall constitute the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the L icense of the Licensed Unit. 
 
 T h is License Agreement is subject to all terms and conditions of the Agreement to Sell. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the Agreement to Sell shall prevail, and any conflicting term(s) in the License Agreement shall be deemed to have been amended appropriately. 
 
 A ny modification or amendment to this L icense Agreement shall be in writing and expressly stating the intention to modify, amend or waive any provision of this L icense Agreement, duly signed by both Parties. 
 
 This License Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Pakistan , the C ourts of Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction. 
 
 Any notice required to be served under the License Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail, to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in the Agreement to Sell or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. The Licensee shall notify the Licensor in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the License Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940. After the lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 Th is License Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which together shall constitute the same License Agreement.
